name: SupplementSameUrlUnversioned
description: A supplement with the url of the code system it supplements (as dk.ehealth.sundhed.fhir.ig.core does for data-absent-reason): url|2.0.0 claims to be version 2.0.0 of that code system, which it is not, so this is an error. The supplements reference has no version here; it is the url that is compared
